paragraphs: A full-stack fitness tracking hub for athletes who take their nutrition and lifting seriously — monitor calories, log gym sessions, and visualize consistency through a premium, data-driven interface.

Most fitness apps either track food or training — NutriGain does both, and does them beautifully. Designed for athletes who obsess over the details, NutriGain is a precision-first fitness tracking platform built to eliminate guesswork from your diet and training.
Instead of scattered spreadsheets and basic calorie counters, NutriGain gives you a unified, data-rich dashboard where you can:
features: Hit your macros — track calories, protein, carbs, and fats in real time with a curated meal database
Log your lifts — record every set as real numbers (kg × reps) per exercise, with automatic PR detection and progression charts
Stay consistent — a GitHub-style activity heatmap, fed by real training volume, makes your habits impossible to ignore
Stay accountable — a day-level daily log ties nutrition and gym sessions together in one place
